title: Staff Embedded Software Engineer - Networking Platforms
description:
Staff Embedded Software Engineer - Networking Platforms This role has been designed as Onsite with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office. Who We Are: Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE. What You ll Do 
 Design, develop, enhance, troubleshoot, and debug system and platform software for enterprise networking products across Junos and EVO environments. Develop and maintain C software, including Linux device drivers and components that interact with platform hardware, firmware, buses, and system interfaces. Contribute to board, system, and platform bring-up, diagnosing issues across software and hardware layers. Lead technical work through solution design, analysis, implementation, testing, and integration, coordinating with hardware, software, and development partners. Design and integrate software across platforms, contributing to the architecture of products and solutions. Build and support multi-threaded, multi-process, and multi-daemon systems. Review designs and project work against engineering standards, providing feedback to improve quality, reliability, and reduce failure risk. Develop and execute test plans; debug software and use test scripts and tools to verify system behavior. Provide technical expertise to cross-functional projects and help evaluate and integrate relevant technologies. Mentor junior engineers and communicate designs, risks, and technical options to engineering teams and senior stakeholders. 
 What You Need to Bring 
 Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Typically 8-12 years of relevant software engineering experience. Candidates with approximately 7 or more years may be considered if their technical depth and scope match the staff-level role. Strong C programming skills and experience developing platform, system, or embedded software. Hands-on Linux device-driver development or substantial driver-level systems experience. Experience with system, board, or platform bring-up and software that interacts with hardware or low-level interfaces. Solid understanding of operating systems, processes, and threads, plus experience with multithreaded software or complex system services. Strong knowledge of data structures, debugging, and systematic problem-solving. Experience contributing to software architecture and integrating system components into a product or platform. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain designs and discuss technical options with senior stakeholders. Ability to own complex work independently, ramp up quickly, and guide or mentor other engineers. Good to have: Ethernet switching, enterprise networking, TCP/IP, or routing and switching experience. Good to have: Junos, EVO, FreeBSD, C++, or comparable network operating-system experience. Good to have: Experience with PCIe, I2C, UART, SPI, MDIO, FPGA/CPLD, x86 or ARM platforms, chassis management, virtual chassis, or Power over Ethernet. Good to have: Familiarity with network processors, PHY/SerDes, optics, packet forwarding, high-speed interfaces, MACsec, storage, system peripherals, or telemetry. Good to have: Interest in using AI-enabled tools thoughtfully to improve engineering productivity, with appropriate review and validation. Accessibility

title: Senior Solution Architect
description:
Solution Architect / Senior Solution Architect / Principal Architect / Enterprise Architect Job Description 
 Who we're looking for A Client-Facing Builder-Architect : someone who can talk trade-offs with a client in the morning and be deep in the logs with the dev team by the afternoon. You bridge business goals and technical execution, and you stay close enough to the code to know what you're advising on. As a Solution Architect, you own the end-to-end technical solution. You're the person a client's leadership trusts to turn a business goal into a design, and the person engineers trust to make that design work in practice. Your mantra: design, validate and deliver the right end-to-end solution. 
 Here's what you look like: A trusted advisor. You're a technical sounding board for client technology and business leaders, and you translate dense tech into business value, risk and cost. A zero-ego builder. No ivory tower. You write proofs of concepts, review critical code and dig through logs alongside the developers. Calm when it counts. When production breaks or an escalation land, you get methodical and steady, and the room settles with you. Diplomatic with pushback. You handle client trade-offs and disagreements with confidence and good grace. Commercially pragmatic. You pick business outcomes and delivery speed over a perfect, over-engineered stack. Globally minded. You lead distributed teams and bridge US client expectations with India-based delivery pods. Full-stack engineering mindset: Demonstrate a full-stack engineering mindset, with the ability to understand and work across the complete application stack, including frontend, backend, APIs, databases, integrations, cloud infrastructure, deployment, security, performance, and observability, as relevant to the solution. AI-forward. You use generative AI and AI-assisted engineering tools (LLMs, GitHub Copilot, Claude) in solutions and delivery workflows, with human oversight, security, privacy and governance. At home in digital learning. You're comfortable with frameworks like LTI, Ed-Fi, QTI and CEDS in enterprise platform ecosystems. 
 About the role We're hiring a Architects: a client-facing technical leader who turns business objectives into end-to-end solutions, then drives them from presales all the way through implementation and production. You'll blend client advisory, solution architecture, hands-on problem-solving and delivery leadership. You'll be comfortable in a room with senior client stakeholders, and close enough to engineering to validate decisions and untangle complex technical challenges yourself. Location: [Remote / Hybrid / On-site City] Reports to: [Head of Architecture / Engineering Leader] 
 What you'll do Sit down with client technology and business leaders to understand their strategic goals, business challenges and technical constraints. Lead discovery, solution definition, architecture design, technology selection and technical planning for complex applications and enterprise solutions. Lay out solution alternatives, build-versus-buy assessments, modernization strategies and technology roadmaps in terms of business value, risk, cost and delivery impact. Define the end-to-end architecture across application, integration, data, cloud, security and infrastructure, as the solution needs. Stay hands-on: build proofs of concept, run critical code reviews, validate technical designs, run system diagnostics and solve the complex problems. Guide engineering teams through implementation and keep the delivered solution true to the architectural intent and business requirements. Own technical risk across the solution lifecycle: set mitigation and contingency plans and drive critical issues to resolution. Partner with Project Managers and delivery leadership to balance technical feasibility, delivery commitments, scope and commercial considerations. Hold the bar on technical quality: performance, scalability, security, reliability, accessibility, maintainability and production readiness. Spot opportunities for AI-enabled product capabilities and AI-assisted engineering, and guide their implementation with appropriate human oversight, security, privacy and governance. Lead technical solutioning for presales: discovery, architecture proposals, feasibility, estimation inputs, risk assessment and client presentations. Build trusted relationships with client CTOs, technology leaders, engineering leaders and product stakeholders, and surface modernization opportunities that support account growth. Lead and mentor distributed engineering teams and technical practitioners, keeping client expectations and delivery execution aligned. 
 What you'll bring Strong expertise in solution architecture, enterprise application design, distributed systems, microservices, APIs and integration patterns. Hands-on proficiency in full stack technology, and the ability to validate designs through code, prototypes and technical reviews. Solid experience with cloud-native architectures, AWS or Azure, containers, Kubernetes and infrastructure automation. An understanding of relational and NoSQL databases, event-driven architectures, security, performance, reliability and observability. Practical experience bringing generative AI or AI-assisted engineering tools into solution or delivery workflows. Strong consulting, presales, presentation, negotiation and executive communication skills. A track record of leading distributed teams, handling ambiguity and turning complex technology decisions into business outcomes. 
 Experience and qualifications Typically 10–15 years of relevant technology experience, with significant solution architecture and technical delivery experience. Bachelor's or Master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, IT or a related discipline. Relevant cloud architecture or enterprise architecture certifications are a plus. 
 How you work and communicate Advisor and builder: you can present the options to a client leader and then prove the hard parts in code. Owner: you care how the whole solution performs in production, not just whether the proposal won. Calm under pressure: you stay methodical during outages and client escalations. Commercially aware: you weigh scope, timelines and cost alongside technical feasibility. Bridge builder: you translate between clients, delivery leadership, project managers and engineers, in terms each of them can use. Clear communicator: you explain complex trade-offs in business terms, with confidence and diplomacy. Mentor: you guide Technical Architects and engineers, and you share context generously.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - Flow
description:
Job Description About Flow by ServiceNow Flow is a product and a new business unit in ServiceNow staffed by a team of 0-1 builders. We re creating Flow, an AI-native conversational experience for natural language automation and enterprise service management. Flow is built on a new tech stack with new ways of working. We challenge established practices and are defining a new product and GTM playbook for ServiceNow. Flow puts what we build in front of the largest possible audience. You ll have real ownership of the work, the freedom to move fast, and the resources of a global technology leader behind you. If you have a point of view on building and want to start from the beginning again, we want to talk to you, wherever you are. Plenty of people can ship an AI prototype this year. Few get to build a product that runs enterprise work at global scale. Join us. Job Description We are hiring a hands-on Senior Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer who serves as the technical champion for customers, guiding them from their first demo and trial to long-term success with Flow. You will demonstrate the product, answer technical questions, set up and enable Flow, and help customers build automations and integrations through AI-assisted, natural-language development. You will solve problems the product does not yet handle and translate customer needs into clear requirements that help product managers prioritize what to build next. The role combines technical implementation, customer success, and support. Ready to be the person who turns we re stuck into we re live We re looking for a hybrid problem-solver who helps trial customers and enterprise IT teams unlock the full power of Flow. You will own complex customer problems end to end, and your work will shape what Flow does next. What You Will Do Technical Solutions Work with customer IT and security teams to configure SSO and integrations with tools such as Okta, Microsoft Teams, Slack, and ServiceNow. Build, test, and launch automations with Flow s natural-language builder, connecting to tools such as Jira, Workday, Zoom, Microsoft 365, and ServiceNow. Connect document sources such as SharePoint, Google Drive, Box, Notion, and the ServiceNow knowledge base so the AI returns accurate, sourced answers. Solve complex customer requirements outside the standard product, document effective workarounds, and turn customer learnings into clear product requirements that you help refine and shepherd through delivery. Build proof-of-concept solutions and workflows for strategic evaluations. Customer Success and Adoption Guide new customers through a structured onboarding path, setting up and enabling Flow in a few hours so they can reach a live production deployment in one day. Monitor usage, conversation allowances, and automation results in Flow analytics, using the data to demonstrate value and identify new automation opportunities. Identify opportunities to expand Flow from an initial use case into a broader self-service service desk. Translate customer pain points and requests into clear product requirements, then partner with product and engineering to refine and shepherd them through delivery. Support and Reliability Own first-line triage for trial and enterprise customers, answering technical questions and escalating issues when deeper product or engineering support is needed. Be the go-to person when customers encounter API timeouts, sync errors, payment-related questions, or failed automations, and drive issues from initial diagnosis through resolution. Reproduce bugs, isolate root causes, and work directly with core engineers to resolve them. Monitor health, audit, and activity logs to identify outages or issues that prevent customers from using Flow fully. Use Flow audit and activity logs to diagnose complex customer issues, confirm what happened, and drive the issue to resolution. Qualifications 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role, such as forward deployed, solutions, or implementation engineering, in enterprise software. Hands-on experience with REST APIs, scripting, automations, and webhooks, with comfort testing them using tools such as Postman or cURL. Working knowledge of single sign-on and identity providers, including SAML, OAuth, Okta, and Entra ID. Experience with enterprise service management or collaboration tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, Slack, or Microsoft Teams. Familiarity with AI and workflow automation, including prompt design and how AI systems retrieve information from documents. Communicate clearly with stakeholders from IT directors to system administrators and security engineers. See how Flow fits into a customer s broader IT and operations strategy and ServiceNow s plans. Demonstrated ability to take ownership of customer outcomes while partnering effectively across product, engineering, support, and customer teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience with service desk offerings. Experience with AI-native or cloud-native enterprise products. Background in product-led growth or consumption-priced software. Experience building an onboarding or implementation motion from scratch; startup experience is helpful but not required.

title: QA Automation & Performance Test Engineer
description:
Job Description QA Automation & Performance Test Engineer Position: QA Automation & Performance Test Engineer Experience: 3–7 Years Employment Type: Full-Time 
 Job Summary We are looking for a dedicated and experienced QA Automation & Performance Test Engineer to strengthen our QA team. The candidate should have strong hands-on experience in test automation using Playwright and Selenium , along with expertise in performance and load testing. The resource will be responsible for expanding automation coverage across application modules, developing and maintaining reliable automation scripts, and performing performance and load testing to ensure application stability, scalability, and reliability. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Automation Testing Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using Playwright and Selenium . Build and enhance automation frameworks using JavaScript/TypeScript and other relevant programming languages. Identify test scenarios suitable for automation and expand automation coverage across different application modules. Execute automated test suites and analyze test results. Integrate automation scripts into CI/CD pipelines. Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve automation script failures. Maintain reusable, scalable, and reliable automation scripts. Collaborate with manual QA and development teams to ensure comprehensive test coverage. 
 2. Performance and Load Testing Design and execute performance, load, stress, and scalability tests. Develop performance test scenarios based on real-world user workflows. Conduct load testing to evaluate application behavior under different user loads. Identify performance bottlenecks in application response times, database operations, APIs, and server resources. Analyze performance test results and prepare detailed reports. Work closely with development and infrastructure teams to identify and resolve performance issues. Validate application stability under normal, peak, and high-load conditions. 
 Technical Skills Required Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in Manual Testing is essential and considered a key requirement for this role. Hands-on experience with Playwright and/or Selenium automation . Good knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript; knowledge of other relevant programming languages is an advantage. Experience in developing and maintaining automation frameworks. Hands-on experience with performance/load testing tools such as: Apache JMeter LoadRunner WAPT Experience in API testing and automation. Knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP protocols, and browser developer tools. Understanding of CI/CD pipelines. Ability to analyze test execution results, identify issues, and prepare test reports. 
 Preferred Skills Experience in web application and native/mobile application testing. Knowledge of SQL and database validation. Experience in identifying application performance bottlenecks. Experience integrating automation and performance testing into CI/CD workflows. 
 Expected Outcomes Expand and strengthen automation coverage across application modules. Reduce repetitive manual testing efforts through automation. Improve automation execution efficiency and reliability. Establish and maintain performance/load testing scenarios. Identify performance bottlenecks before production releases. Provide actionable automation and performance testing reports to the QA and development teams. 
 Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate should be a self-driven QA professional capable of independently handling automation and performance testing activities, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and contributing to overall product quality and release readiness

title: Senior Linux Infrastructure Operations Engineer - Linux P3 production
description:
Job Summary This role is responsible for managing and optimizing the company's Linux environments, primarily RHEL and Oracle Linux. It focuses on core activities such as server administration, security, and performance, with an emphasis on supporting production of Linux infrastructure. The selected candidate will work with the Engineering team to drive architecture and design improvements. Several of the responsibilities outlined below reflect the organization's target-state vision, which the successful candidate will help define and implement. Responsibilities System Installation and Configuration: Deploy and configure Linux-based operating systems (RHEL, Oracle Linux) on servers including setting up network parameters, storage, and security settings. User Management: Administer centralized authentication and identity management platforms such as Red Hat IdM. Create and maintain user groups, role-based access controls (RBAC), and host-based access controls. Configure and manage sudo policies, privileged command delegation, and privileged access monitoring. Perform regular access reviews and recertification activities to identify excessive permissions and inactive accounts. Patching Management: Administer and maintain software repositories, content views, and package management infrastructure using Red Hat Satellite. Deploy software updates, patches, hotfixes, and security remediations via Ansible Automation Platform. Ensure all servers remain compliant with organizational security, vulnerability management, and software lifecycle policies. Troubleshoot package installation, repository connectivity, dependency conflicts, and software update failures. Generate compliance and patch status reports for management, audit, and security teams. Server Maintenance: Maintain the health, stability, and security of Linux server environments, primarily Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) and Oracle Linux (OEL). Register and manage Linux servers within Red Hat Satellite. Apply and maintain security hardening standards, ensuring compliance with organizational security requirements. Maintain server inventories, configuration baselines, and lifecycle documentation. Troubleshoot and resolve server-related incidents, including hardware, operating system, and storage. Automate routine maintenance activities using Ansible, shell scripting, and enterprise automation platforms. Monitoring and Performance Optimization: Monitor server health, system performance, resource utilization, and service availability across physical and virtual Linux environments. Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve performance bottlenecks affecting CPU, memory, storage, network, and application services. Perform regular system health checks and optimisation activities to maximize uptime, efficiency, and operational stability. Analyse system metrics, logs, and audit data to identify recurring incidents, root causes, and opportunities for automation and improvement. A working knowledge of SCOM monitoring tool and ServiceNow is an asset. Troubleshooting and Issue Resolution: Diagnose, investigate, and resolve complex Linux operating system, network, storage, and infrastructure issues across enterprise environments. Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for incidents and recurring problems, implementing permanent corrective actions to prevent reoccurrence. Lead the resolution of critical production incidents, ensuring minimal service disruption and adherence to agreed service levels. Troubleshoot issues related to RHEL, virtualization platforms, identity management,storage, networking, backup solutions, and automation tools. Develop and maintain troubleshooting procedures, knowledge articles, and technical documentation to improve operational effectiveness. Conduct post-incident reviews and recommend service improvements, configuration changes, and preventative maintenance activities. Backup and Disaster Recovery: manage system backup to ensure data integrity and contribute to disaster recovery plan activation or testing. Shell Scripting and Automation: Code and maintain shell scripts and automation tools to streamline repetitive tasks and improve system efficiency. Automate routine administrative tasks using shell scripting / Ansible. Knowledge of Ansible, playbook and YAML is desired. Virtualization: Manage virtual machines (e.g., VMware, Nutanix) System Security Auditing and Compliance: Conduct security audits and ensure Linux systems comply with relevant security standards and policies. Continuous Learning: Stay up to date with the latest advancements in Linux technologies and acquire new skills to enhance system administration capabilities. Collaboration: Coordinate with other IT teams, developers, and stakeholders to support various projects and ensure smooth integration of Linux systems with other components. Documentation: Maintain a comprehensive documentation of system configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps for future reference. Availability: Be available on call as per the on-call roster including on weekends to implement planned changes OR resolve production outages. Extend shift if required to resolve production outages. Continuous service improvements: Initiate, own and implement service improvements including automation that can improve processes, reduce outages, incidents, make environment more stable, reduce effort required to support, minimize/mitigate risks, improve customer satisfaction etc. The above responsibilities may be revised as per the business requirement. Requirements Minimum 8 years' experience in supporting production Linux server infrastructure. Minimum 3 years' experience in Level 3 role supporting more than 300 Linux servers. Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or equivalent combination of education and experience in a related field Worker Type Employee Job Type Regular

Analyse current-state lending processes and define future-state operating models. Identify opportunities to optimise LoanIQ utilisation and automate manual processes. Collaborate with development teams to validate functionality against business requirements. Partner with stakeholders across agency services, lender servicing, settlements, accounting, treasury, finance, and risk functions. Contribute to Target Operating Model (TOM) design, process reengineering, and operational readiness activities. Drive process improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, controls, and regulatory compliance. Data Migration Legacy Platform Transformation Support migration from legacy lending platforms such as ACBS to LoanIQ. Coordinate with vendors and system integrators to ensure successful migration delivery. Testing Implementation Support Develop and review test scenarios, test scripts, and UAT documentation. You have experience supporting LoanIQ implementations, upgrades, migrations, or lending transformation programmes. title: Senior IT Systems Administrator
description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior IT Systems Administrator to support and administer a portfolio of pro-code and low-code enterprise applications, with a focus on supply chain and Enterprise Document Management Systems (EDMS). This role sits at the intersection of IT and business operations, requiring technical depth in SQL and Oracle APEX, as well as the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, actionable solutions. 
 The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams, supporting the analysis, design, and optimization of document lifecycle processes within a legacy supply chain and EDMS environment overlaid with Oracle APEX low-code solutions. As a partner to business customers, this role will support innovation and digital transformation by identifying opportunities to modernize workflows, automate manual activities, and deliver practical, customer-focused improvements that create measurable business value. 
 Familiarity with supply chain processes - including vendor sourcing, competitive bidding (RFI/RFQ/RFP), and procurement - combined with knowledge of document management concepts such as Master Document Register (MDR), revision control, transmittals, and distribution matrices, will distinguish the strongest candidates. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Requirements & Analysis Elicit, document, and validate business requirements related to supply chain and document management activities, partnering with business customers to identify pain points and prioritize innovation and digital transformation opportunities based on business value, feasibility, and risk. Develop use cases, process flow diagrams, and functional specifications for enhancements or implementations. 
 Stakeholder Engagement Partner with business units, IT, records management, legal, and compliance teams to align document management practices with organizational goals. Facilitate workshops, interviews, and Joint Application Design (JAD) sessions to gather and refine requirements. Serve as a liaison between end users and technical development teams throughout the project lifecycle, helping business customers translate ideas into actionable digital solutions and understand proposed changes and expected benefits. 
 Testing & Implementation Support Develop and execute test plans, test cases, and User Acceptance Test (UAT) scripts for changes and releases. Coordinate user acceptance testing and track defects through resolution, working with business customers to validate that new digital capabilities meet agreed requirements and support intended business outcomes. Assist with data migration planning, validation, and cutover activities. 
 Documentation & Training Author business process documentation, quick reference cards, user guides, and training materials. Deliver end-user training and provide post-implementation support to help business customers adopt new digital capabilities, embed improved ways of working, and provide feedback for continuous improvement. Maintain requirement traceability matrices and project documentation artifacts. 
 Business Process Automation & Enablement Partner with business stakeholders to analyze and improve business processes using low-code automation tools, supporting digital transformation through workflow modernization, reduced manual effort, and improved access to actionable information. Translate business requirements into scalable, supportable, and governed solutions; evaluate innovative approaches through targeted proofs of concept and recommend practical improvements based on business customer needs and measurable benefits. Review existing automations and applications for performance, maintainability, and compliance with standards. Provide technical guidance and mentoring to citizen developers and solution owners. 
 Collaboration & Governance Work closely with IT leadership, architects, security, database, document management, and compliance teams. Support cutover coordination, issue resolution, and organizational change management activities. Participate in governance, planning, and operational review meetings related to automation and business process platforms, aligning innovation and digital transformation initiatives with business priorities, architecture standards, security, and compliance requirements. Contribute to documentation, standards, and operational procedures. 
 Required Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or equivalent experience. 5+ years of experience administering or supporting pro-code and low-code applications in an enterprise environment. Proficient in data extraction and analysis; well versed in SQL query creation and review with a solid understanding of database relationships. Experience authoring and supporting Power BI reports and dashboards. Working knowledge of Single Sign-On and identity management protocols: Entra ID, SCIM, OAuth, OIDC (OpenID Connect), and SAML. Ability to write, develop, and manage Oracle APEX applications. Knowledge of application lifecycle management (ALM) for low-code platforms. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Analytical and conceptual thinking skills, with the ability to identify opportunities for innovation and digital transformation and translate business customer needs into practical process and technology improvements.

Working knowledge of supply chain processes such as supplier management, vendor sourcing, competitive bidding (RFI/RFQ/RFP), and procurement. Working knowledge of document management concepts such as master document register (MDR), document numbering and coding, revision control, document status codes, transmittals, and distribution matrices. Experience with both Oracle and SQL Server databases. Experience supporting SaaS applications such as DocuSign, Amazon Business, Cority Greenstone, and Optro (formerly Auditboard). Familiarity with AI-assisted automation tools such as Databricks, Claude, or Microsoft Copilot Studio. Experience in a business process analyst or hybrid IT/business role, preferably supporting business-led innovation, digital transformation, or application modernization initiatives from opportunity assessment through implementation and adoption. Understanding of enterprise governance, compliance, and change management practices. 
 Key Skills & Competencies: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and business audiences. Ability to work independently while coordinating across multiple teams. Detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality, governance, and sustainability, combined with an innovation mindset and a customer-focused approach to continuous improvement and digital transformation. Proven ability to support both pro-code and low-code solutions in a controlled enterprise environment.

title: Lead analyst
description:
Position Description
 Job Summary
 Experience Required: 610+ Years
 We are seeking an experienced Senior z/OS Systems Administrator (L3 Support) to join our Core Mainframe Infrastructure Services team. In this senior, escalated technical role, you will act as the highest level of internal technical escalation for operating system incidents, complex systems engineering, system migrations, and operational resilience across mission critical enterprise IBM Z environments.
 The successful candidate will lead complex problem resolution, drive major operating system upgrades—including migrations from z/OS 3.1 to z/OS 3.2—oversee JES3 spool/batch subsystems, manage advanced MVS console alerting, and ensure robust disaster recovery and storage redundancy utilizing CSM (Copy Services Manager). This position works closely with architecture, storage, automation, and application infrastructure teams to guarantee non stop system availability, strict SLA compliance, and continuous modernization of the mainframe landscape.
 Key Responsibilities
 1. Level 3 Incident Management & Advanced Triage
 . Serve as the final technical escalation point (L3) for complex, high impact system incidents, critical outages, and recurring system anomalies across production Sysplex environments.
 . Perform in depth root cause analysis (RCA) on system abends, wait states, hard/soft loops, and system crashes; analyze standalone dumps (SADUMP), IPCS dump captures, and SYSLOG / OPERLOG data.
 . Deliver rapid remediation during major system incidents, orchestrating complex emergency actions, IPL sequencing, and dynamic system reconfiguration.
 2. Operating System Migrations & SMP/E Engineering
 . Plan, architect, and execute operating system release upgrades, specifically leading migration paths from z/OS 3.1 to z/OS 3.2.
 . Oversee SMP/E environments for installing, upgrading, and maintaining z/OS software products, PTFs, APARs, PUT buckets, and RSU maintenance levels.
 . Validate system compatibility, upgrade pre requisites, hardware co existence, fallback procedures, and validation test suites across all sandbox, QA, and production LPARs.
 . Maintain and customize critical system configurations: PARMLIB (IEASYSxx, LOADxx, LPALSTxx, LNKLSTxx), PROCLIB, and system symbolics.
 3. MVS Console Operations, Alerts & Automation
 . Direct MVS console operations, console topology configuration, message routing, command security, and master console failover policies.
 . Monitor, triage, and configure critical system alert mechanisms, WTO/WTOR handling, console flood prevention, and system automation intercept routines.
 . Partner with automation engineers to develop and refine automated operator interventions, incident suppression rules, and auto ticketing triggers.
 4. Job Entry Subsystem (JES3) Administration
 . Administer, tune, and maintain complex JES3 multi system complex (JES3plex) environments, including Global and Local processor setups.
 . Manage JES3 initialization streams, spool space allocations, spool offload/reload procedures, dynamic device reconfiguration, and job routing rules.
 . Provide deep diagnostic troubleshooting for JES3 spool stalls, communication timeouts, converter/interpreter errors, and complex batch queue blockages.
 5. High Availability, Storage Redundancy & CSM
 . Administer and configure CSM (Copy Services Manager) to manage replication sessions (Metro Mirror, Global Mirror, and HyperSwap) for critical system redundancy and data resiliency.
 . Coordinate with Enterprise Storage teams on DASD/tape allocation, coupling facility structures, SMS constructs, and catalog recovery.
 . Ensure automated failover capabilities and continuous availability across multi site Parallel Sysplex environments.
 6. Archiving & Output Management Tools
 . Oversee administration and L3 troubleshooting for enterprise report and log archiving tools, specifically CA View (Broadcom Output Management) and Flasher.
 . Manage archival database maintenance, index recoveries, automated purging cycles, bundle definitions, and report distribution stability.
 . Support end user and operations team inquiries related to archived Syslog retrieval, batch utility output retention, and compliance auditing.
 7. Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity
 . Lead technical planning, script development, and technical execution for enterprise Mainframe Disaster Recovery (DR) and business continuity drills.
 . Validate disaster recovery readiness utilizing CSM failover scripts, alternative site IPLs, and catalog synchronization.
 . Maintain and update disaster recovery runbooks, recovery time objective (RTO) targets, and recovery point objective (RPO) guarantees.
 8. Mentorship, Governance & Continuous Improvement
 . Provide technical leadership and hands on mentoring to L1/L2 operations and systems administration staff.
 . Review change records, conduct peer reviews on critical maintenance packages, and evaluate architectural impact assessments.
 . Drive operational efficiency through REXX scripting, automated health checks, and modern infrastructure tooling.
 Required Qualifications
 . Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
 . Experience: Minimum of 6–10+ years of dedicated, hands on experience in IBM z/OS System Administration and L3 Production Engineering.
 . Track Record: Demonstrated background in supporting high volume, 24x7 mission critical financial, enterprise, or government mainframe operations.
 Required Technical Skills
 Core z/OS Systems & Subsystems
 . Comprehensive mastery of z/OS Architecture & Administration (including latest z/OS 3.1 and release readiness for z/OS 3.2).
 . Advanced SMP/E (RECEIVE, APPLY, ACCEPT, RESTORE, SMPPTS, and CSI management).
 . Hands on expertise in JES3 environments (JES3plex, spool management, initialization decks, Global/Local operations).
 . MVS Console Architecture: Console operations, routing codes, command authority, message flood automation, and alert triage.
 . Deep knowledge of PARMLIB / PROCLIB management, dynamic I/O configuration (HCD), and Workload Manager (WLM).
 . Utilities and diagnostics: IPCS dump reading, AMASPZAP, IDCAMS, DUMP/RESTORE (DFSMSdss), IEBCOPY, and DSNUTILS.
 Resiliency & Redundancy
 . Copy Services Manager (CSM) administration for multi site replication, HyperSwap monitoring, and storage redundancy.
 . Parallel Sysplex concepts: Sysplex Timers (STP), Coupling Facility (CF) structures, and CDS management.
 Specialized Tools & Utilities
 . Report & log archiving suites: CA View and Flasher.
 . Scripting & Automation: REXX, CLIST, and JCL mastery.
 . Security: RACF/ ACF2 (profiles, certificates, class administration, and audit remediation).
 . Output and spool utilities: (E)JES, or equivalent spool navigation tools.
 Preferred Qualifications
 . IBM Certified System Administrator – z/OS.
 . Experience with JES3 to JES2 migration strategies and assessment planning.
 . Familiarity with database/middleware subsystems: IBM Db2 for z/OS, IMS, CICS, and IBM MQ.
 . Exposure to Mainframe Modernization: z/OSMF workflows, Ansible for z/OS, and Git based source management.
 Key Competencies
 . L3 Diagnostic Acumen: Proven ability to rapidly isolate root causes across interconnected hardware, operating system, network, and storage layers.
 . Crisis Management: Composure and decisive leadership when driving bridge calls during severe production outages and emergency IPLs.
 . Clear Technical Communication: Aptitude for articulating complex technical incidents into clear stakeholder summaries and executive RCA documents.
 . Continuous Improvement: Passion for automating repetitive manual checks and modernizing legacy processes.
 Working Conditions
 . Scheduled weekend and off hours coverage during planned OS migrations, major maintenance windows, and disaster recovery exercises.
 . Collaboration with global engineering teams and operational hubs across multiple time zones.

description:
Role & responsibilities The Technical Consultant - ERP is responsible for the analysis, design, configuration, implementation, and ongoing support of the companys on-premise SAP HR/Payroll environment. This role will serve as a subject matter expert for SAP HR/Payroll configuration and processing. This role will collaborate with business stakeholders, IT teams, vendors, and other technology partners to define solutions that meet business requirements and organizational objectives. The SAP HR/Payroll Architect will also provide technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and mentoring to other team members while ensuring solutions are aligned with established development, change management, security, and support processes. Key Responsibilities: Implement and/or support on-premise SAP HR/Payroll ECC 6 EHP8 in a manufacturing environment. Serve as a subject matter expert for SAP Payroll with experience in Personnel Administration, Organizational Management, and Benefits configuration . Analyze business requirements and translate them into effective SAP HR/Payroll designs and configuration solutions. Develop alternative solutions, evaluate options, and present recommendations to business stakeholders and IT management. Configure, test, implement, and support SAP HR/Payroll changes within a formal System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and change management methodology. Provide ongoing production support, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and resolution of complex SAP HR/Payroll issues. Implement, maintain, support, and troubleshoot the Rsite Tax Engine , including coordination with Rimini Street and the application, testing, and validation of tax updates and releases. Manage the impact of Rsite Tax Engine updates on SAP Payroll , including payroll configuration, tax calculations, testing, regression testing, and production implementation. Partner with Rimini Street and other vendors to investigate and resolve tax engine, payroll, and integration-related issues. Support payroll tax compliance activities by ensuring applicable federal, state, and local tax updates are appropriately tested and implemented in the Rsite Tax Engine/SAP Payroll environment. Understand and manage integration touchpoints between SAP HR/Payroll, Rsite Tax Engine, SuccessFactors, Kronos Workforce Management, and other downstream or upstream applications . Implement and support SaaS solutions and their integrations with SAP HR/Payroll. Manage, prioritize, and complete support requests for a large and complex organization. Estimate and plan work effort for projects, enhancements, upgrades, tax updates, and production support activities. Independently perform technical, configuration, testing, documentation, and process-related activities. Develop and maintain appropriate system documentation, configuration documentation, test scripts, and support procedures. Work collaboratively across HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, and external vendor teams with a focus on overall business success. Build strong relationships and trust with business users, IT stakeholders, vendors, and management. Provide knowledge transfer and training to team members and end users as appropriate. Effectively manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced, and constantly changing environment. 

 Preferred candidate profile 
 Bachelors degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience. 5 –8 years of hands-on SAP HR/Payroll experience , including configuration and production support. Strong technical and functional knowledge of SAP HR/Payroll ECC 6 . Strong experience with SAP Payroll including experience with Personnel Administration, , Benefits configuration , and Financial Postings . Demonstrated experience supporting payroll tax processing and tax-related configuration . Hands-on experience with Rimini Street Rsite Tax Engine , including implementation, configuration/support, testing, and application of tax updates. Other tax engine experience will be considered. Experience working with Rimini Street and coordinating the implementation and testing of vendor-provided tax and payroll updates is a plus. Understanding of integrations between SAP HR/Payroll and external HR, payroll, tax, and other applications. Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills. Experience working within a formal SDLC/change management process , including requirements gathering, design, configuration, testing, implementation, and documentation. Ability to communicate effectively with end users, IT staff, business stakeholders, and management. Excellent communication, documentation, collaboration, and knowledge-transfer skills. Proactive self-starter with the ability to learn new technologies and business processes and utilize available resources effectively. Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a complex, fast-paced environment. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with SAP SuccessFactors . Experience with Kronos Workforce Management version 8 or higher . Experience with Rsite , BSI TaxFactory/TUBs, and/or other SAP payroll tax solutions . Experience with SaaS HR/payroll solutions and enterprise application integrations. Experience coordinating with third-party application and managed-service providers. Experience with payroll tax compliance, year-end processing, and tax update testing. Experience leading SAP HR/Payroll projects, enhancements, or major production initiatives.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Server Engineer to manage, optimize, and support our enterprise server and storage infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in VMware virtualization, Linux systems administration, and enterprise storage platforms

Collaborate with application, network, and security teams for infrastructure integration.

Expertise in Linux (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu) system administration, scripting (Bash, Python, or Ansible preferred). 
Proven experience with HPE (3PAR, Primera) and Hitachi VSP storage systems including replication, thin provisioning, and performance tuning. 
Knowledge of SAN/NAS technologies, zoning, multipathing, and fabric management (Brocade/Cisco MDS). 
Familiarity with backup solutions (Veeam, Commvault, NetBackup) and disaster recovery processes. 
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
Experience in capacity planning, performance optimization, and infrastructure automation. 
Excellent communication skills and ability to work in cross-functional teams. 

 Soft Skills & Expectations: 
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills in complex environments. 
Ability to lead projects independently and mentor junior team members. 
Effective communicator able to convey technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
Proficient in documentation, change management, and risk assessment.

Title: Senior IT Systems Administrator We are seeking an experienced Senior IT Systems Administrator to support and administer a portfolio of pro-code and low-code enterprise applications, with a focus on supply chain and Enterprise Document Management Systems (EDMS). This role sits at the intersection of IT and business operations, requiring technical depth in SQL and Oracle APEX, as well as the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, actionable solutions. 
 The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams, supporting the analysis, design, and optimization of document lifecycle processes within a legacy supply chain and EDMS environment overlaid with Oracle APEX low-code solutions. As a partner to business customers, this role will support innovation and digital transformation by identifying opportunities to modernize workflows, automate manual activities, and deliver practical, customer-focused improvements that create measurable business value. 
 Familiarity with supply chain processes - including vendor sourcing, competitive bidding (RFI/RFQ/RFP), and procurement - combined with knowledge of document management concepts such as Master Document Register (MDR), revision control, transmittals, and distribution matrices, will distinguish the strongest candidates. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
Requirements & Analysis Elicit, document, and validate business requirements related to supply chain and document management activities, partnering with business customers to identify pain points and prioritize innovation and digital transformation opportunities based on business value, feasibility, and risk. Develop use cases, process flow diagrams, and functional specifications for enhancements or implementations. 
Stakeholder Engagement Partner with business units, IT, records management, legal, and compliance teams to align document management practices with organizational goals. Facilitate workshops, interviews, and Joint Application Design (JAD) sessions to gather and refine requirements. Serve as a liaison between end users and technical development teams throughout the project lifecycle, helping business customers translate ideas into actionable digital solutions and understand proposed changes and expected benefits. 
Testing & Implementation Support Develop and execute test plans, test cases, and User Acceptance Test (UAT) scripts for changes and releases. Coordinate user acceptance testing and track defects through resolution, working with business customers to validate that new digital capabilities meet agreed requirements and support intended business outcomes. Assist with data migration planning, validation, and cutover activities. 
Documentation & Training Author business process documentation, quick reference cards, user guides, and training materials. Deliver end-user training and provide post-implementation support to help business customers adopt new digital capabilities, embed improved ways of working, and provide feedback for continuous improvement. Maintain requirement traceability matrices and project documentation artifacts. 
Business Process Automation & Enablement Partner with business stakeholders to analyze and improve business processes using low-code automation tools, supporting digital transformation through workflow modernization, reduced manual effort, and improved access to actionable information. Translate business requirements into scalable, supportable, and governed solutions; evaluate innovative approaches through targeted proofs of concept and recommend practical improvements based on business customer needs and measurable benefits. Review existing automations and applications for performance, maintainability, and compliance with standards. Provide technical guidance and mentoring to citizen developers and solution owners. 
Collaboration & Governance Work closely with IT leadership, architects, security, database, document management, and compliance teams. Support cutover coordination, issue resolution, and organizational change management activities. Participate in governance, planning, and operational review meetings related to automation and business process platforms, aligning innovation and digital transformation initiatives with business priorities, architecture standards, security, and compliance requirements. Contribute to documentation, standards, and operational procedures. 
 Required Qualifications: Bachelors degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or equivalent experience. 5+ years of experience administering or supporting pro-code and low-code applications in an enterprise environment. Proficient in data extraction and analysis; well versed in SQL query creation and review with a solid understanding of database relationships. Experience authoring and supporting Power BI reports and dashboards. Working knowledge of Single Sign-On and identity management protocols: Entra ID, SCIM, OAuth, OIDC (OpenID Connect), and SAML. Ability to write, develop, and manage Oracle APEX applications. Knowledge of application lifecycle management (ALM) for low-code platforms. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Analytical and conceptual thinking skills, with the ability to identify opportunities for innovation and digital transformation and translate business customer needs into practical process and technology improvements. 
Preferred Qualifications Supply chain and document management domain experience. Working knowledge of supply chain processes such as supplier management, vendor sourcing, competitive bidding (RFI/RFQ/RFP), and procurement. Working knowledge of document management concepts such as master document register (MDR), document numbering and coding, revision control, document status codes, transmittals, and distribution matrices. Experience with both Oracle and SQL Server databases. Experience supporting SaaS applications such as DocuSign, Amazon Business, Cority Greenstone, and Optro (formerly Auditboard). Familiarity with AI-assisted automation tools such as Databricks, Claude, or Microsoft Copilot Studio. Experience in a business process analyst or hybrid IT/business role, preferably supporting business-led innovation, digital transformation, or application modernization initiatives from opportunity assessment through implementation and adoption. Understanding of enterprise governance, compliance, and change management practices. 
Key Skills & Competencies Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and business audiences. Ability to work independently while coordinating across multiple teams. Detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality, governance, and sustainability, combined with an innovation mindset and a customer-focused approach to continuous improvement and digital transformation. Proven ability to support both pro-code and low-code solutions in a controlled enterprise environment. 
Applications Portfolio This role supports the following applications: In-house (Oracle APEX): Supplier Performance Evaluation (SPE), Savings and Value Earned (SAVE), and DocTrac In-house (.NET): KBR Supplier and Buyer SaaS: DocuSign, Amazon Business, Cority Greenstone, Optro (formerly Auditboard)

Strong hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA administration and support. Practical experience working in RISE with SAP environments . Good understanding of SAP Enterprise Cloud Services (ECS) and the RISE operating model. Experience in SAP transport management, client copies, system refreshes, and kernel upgrades. Strong troubleshooting experience in RFC, IDoc, Web Services, and SAP Cloud Connector. Prior experience in SAP AMS / Production Support environments. Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience coordinating directly with SAP ECS and infrastructure support teams. title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Role & responsibilities Company is hiring a GCP Infrastructure Engineer to support cloud operations, platform implementation, and day-to-day infrastructure management for a client's Google Cloud Platform environment. Working under the guidance of the GCP Infrastructure Architect, you will build, operate, and improve the landing zone, security controls, and automation that keep the platform reliable and cost-efficient. 
 Implement and maintain GCP infrastructure components VPC networking, IAM roles, org policies, and resource hierarchy in line with the approved architecture. Provision and manage cloud resources using Terraform (or equivalent IaC), following established standards and code review practices. Apply and monitor security controls, including access management, encryption, and policy enforcement. Set up and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting using Cloud Monitoring / Cloud Logging and related observability tooling. Handle L2 operational support: troubleshoot incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and escalate to the architect where needed. Execute planned changes, patching, and maintenance activities following ITIL-aligned change management processes. Collaborate with the DevOps, Data Engineering, Network Engineering, and Infra/OS team members in the offshore delivery pod. Identify cost-optimisation opportunities (rightsizing, idle resources, committed use) and support their implementation. Maintain clear technical documentation, runbooks, and SOPs for the managed services engagement. 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 45 years of experience in cloud infrastructure or operations roles, with at least 23 years of hands-on work on Google Cloud Platform. Practical experience with core GCP services: Compute Engine, VPC, Cloud IAM, Cloud Storage, GKE, Cloud Load Balancing, and Cloud DNS. Working knowledge of GCP landing zone concepts (networking, IAM, org policy, resource hierarchy). Hands-on experience with Terraform or equivalent IaC tools, and Git-based workflows. Understanding of cloud security fundamentals (IAM, service accounts, VPC firewall rules, encryption). Familiarity with monitoring/observability tools and Linux system administration. Scripting skills in Bash, Python, or similar. Exposure to hybrid/on-prem connectivity (Cloud VPN / Interconnect) is a plus. Good communication skills and willingness to work with international (Middle East) client stakeholders. Preferred Certifications Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer (strongly preferred) Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect (nice to have) ITIL Foundation (useful for the managed services context) Engagement Details Delivery location: Offshore (India-based delivery pod), with periodic coordination with the onsite Delivery/Project Manager. Team context: Reports to the GCP Infrastructure Architect; works alongside GCP DevOps, Data, Network, and Infra/OS engineers and L1 support staff. Allocation: Full-time, dedicated to the client account for the duration of the engagement. Success Metrics Infrastructure changes delivered on time, to standard, and with no security or compliance findings. Platform uptime/reliability targets met per the managed services SLA. Incidents resolved within SLA, with clear documentation and root-cause analysis. Measurable progress on automation and cost-optimisation initiatives.

 Our Story: Founded in 2000 by Dilip Modi, Spice Money Limited is Indias leading rural fintech company, headquartered in Noida and operating as a subsidiary of DiGiSPICE Technologies Limited, a publicly listed entity. The company is driven by a strong mission to accelerate financial inclusion and empower the underserved Bharat” through technology-enabled financial services. With a network of 1.6+ million Adhikaris across India, the company enables last-mile access to essential services including AEPS cash withdrawal and deposits, domestic money transfer, bill payments, insurance, micro-ATM services, credit solutions, travel bookings, account opening, and UPI-led digital payments. Spice Money has consistently introduced industry-first innovations such as a zero-cost Adhikari platform, one of India’s largest assisted payments networks, a rural credit marketplace, and Spice Money UPI & Spice Pay wallet to accelerate digital adoption in smaller towns and villages. Operating across 95%+ pincodes with a team of 1,000+ employees, Spice Money combines the agility of a high-growth fintech with the scale and impact of a nationwide distribution network—creating meaningful economic opportunities and driving the next phase of financial inclusion in India. 
 About the Role We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented fresher to join our Cyber Fraud Operations team. The candidate will support the processing and closure of cases received through the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA), Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C), and assist in responding to queries and requests received from Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs) and other authorities. The role involves case documentation, data analysis, coordination with internal teams, and ensuring timely and accurate responses to authorities. 
 Key Responsibilities Review and process cyber fraud cases received through MHA/I4C channels. Assist in the timely closure of I4C cases in accordance with internal processes and applicable timelines. Prepare and submit responses to Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs), cybercrime authorities, and other authorised government agencies. Coordinate with internal departments such as Risk, Compliance, Operations, Finance, and Customer Support to obtain required information. Maintain accurate case records, trackers, and supporting documentation. Perform data analysis, reconciliation, and reporting using Microsoft Excel. Use basic SQL queries to extract and analyse relevant data from internal databases. Monitor pending cases, follow up on outstanding information, and escalate delays wherever required. Ensure accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance while handling sensitive case-related information. Prepare periodic MIS reports and case status updates for internal stakeholders. Support process improvement initiatives to enhance case turnaround time and operational efficiency. 
 Required Skills & Competencies Microsoft Excel: Good working knowledge of Excel, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, COUNTIF/SUMIF, filters, and data formatting. SQL: Basic knowledge of SQL queries, including SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, and JOIN. Communication: Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and verbal. Coordination: Comfortable working with cross-functional teams and following up with stakeholders. Analytical Skills: Good attention to detail, logical reasoning, and problem-solving abilities. Documentation: Ability to prepare professional emails, reports, and case-related documentation. Learning Attitude: Willingness to learn new systems, processes, and regulatory requirements. 
 Eligibility Criteria Fresh graduates are encouraged to apply. Bachelor’s degree in any discipline. Basic understanding of banking, digital payments, cyber fraud, or financial operations will be an advantage. Candidates with internship experience or academic exposure to Excel and SQL are welcome. No prior professional experience is mandatory. 
 What We Are Looking For A proactive and responsible individual with a strong learning mindset. Someone who can handle repetitive operational tasks with accuracy. A candidate who can manage deadlines and communicate professionally. An individual interested in building a career in Risk, Compliance, Cyber Fraud, or Financial Operations. 
 Interested candidate can share their resume at Kanika.rastogi@spicemoney.com

title: Staff Cloud Services Engineer
description:
Job Title - Staff Cloud Service Engineer III (Microsoft 365 Email Security SMTP) Role Overview: We are seeking an experienced Email Security Microsoft 365 Messaging Engineer to own engineering, operation and continuous improvement of enterprise email platform, mail flow and email security services across a global estate. This is a hands-on technical role for a professional who can take ownership of complex incidents and engineering work, not an entry-level or developmental position. The successful candidate will manage, evolve, support Exchange Online, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Microsoft Purview, Cisco secure email gateways, SMTP relay services Public DNS configuration and hygiene adhering to industry standards. They will work with security, identity, network and application teams, and with suppliers, to keep email secure, deliverable, compliant and reliable. Key Responsibilities Manage the configuration of Cisco secure email gateways, including inbound and outbound routing, policies, quarantine and encryption. Design, manage and troubleshoot Exchange Online services, including transport rules, connectors, accepted and remote domains, mailbox and distribution group settings, and migrations. Design, configure and optimize Microsoft Defender for Office 365 policies, including anti-spam, anti-phishing with impersonation protection, anti-malware, Safe Links, Safe Attachments and pre-set security policies. Own email authentication for all company domains: SPF, DKIM, DMARC Design and support SMTP relay and application email services Onboard and govern applications, devices (such as multifunction printers and scanners) and SaaS platforms that send email on behalf of company domains, making sure they are authenticated, approved and documented. Investigate and remediate phishing, business email compromise, spoofing and malware campaigns with the Security Operations team, using Threat Explorer, message trace, Advanced Hunting and automated investigation and response. Monitor mail flow health, deliverability, queue and reputation issues, using Exchange Admin Centre, Defender portal, message trace, Microsoft 365 Service Health and gateway reporting. Support Microsoft Purview controls that apply to email: data loss prevention, sensitivity labels, message encryption, retention, eDiscovery and journaling. Use ServiceNow and Jira to manage incidents, requests, problems, changes and project activities in line with operational processes. Create and maintain designs, runbooks, mail flow diagrams, standards, domain and sender inventories, and knowledge articles. Provide clear technical guidance and knowledge transfer to service desk teams, application owners and other engineers. Role Scope SMTP relay services for applications, devices and third-party platforms. Exchange Online, and mail flow architecture, including routing through secure email gateways. Microsoft Defender for Office 365 and the wider email threat protection stack. Domain and sender governance: SPF, DKIM, DMARC enforcement and the inventory of approved senders. Email-related identity and access controls, including Conditional Access, modern authentication and the removal of legacy protocols. Email data protection and compliance with Microsoft Purview. Technical leadership during email incidents, including deciding when to block, quarantine, reroute, roll back a change, escalate or engage a specialist. Global service delivery, Incident, Change and Problem Management, root-cause analysis and preventative actions. Automation with PowerShell (Exchange Online, Microsoft Graph), Power Automate and Logic Apps to improve operations and reporting. Mentoring less-experienced engineers and service desk teams. Skills & Experience Exchange Online Messaging Hands-on professional experience engineering and supporting Exchange Online in a large enterprise. Strong knowledge of mail flow: connectors, transport rules, accepted domains, centralized mail transport, and routing through third-party gateways. Experience with mailbox types, shared and resource mailboxes, distribution and Microsoft 365 groups, permissions and migrations. Confident use of message trace, Exchange Admin Centre, Microsoft 365 Service Health and Microsoft support escalation. Email Security Practical experience configuring and tuning Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Experience administering secure email gateway Detailed understanding of SPF, DKIM, DMARC, ARC, MTA-STS and TLS, and experience moving domains to DMARC enforcement. Experience investigating phishing, spoofing and business email compromise with Security Operations teams. Working knowledge of email encryption, data loss prevention and sensitivity labels in Microsoft Purview. SMTP Application Email Deep understanding of SMTP: the protocol, headers, response codes, TLS negotiation, MX and DNS records, and bounce (NDR) analysis. Experience designing and supporting SMTP relay for applications and devices, including authenticated submission, connector-based relay and third-party relay services. Experience planning and delivering the retirement of Basic Authentication and legacy SMTP AUTH. Ability to diagnose deliverability problems blocklists, IP and domain reputation, throttling, and recipient-side rejections. Identity, Automation Operations Working knowledge of Entra ID, Conditional Access, modern authentication and licensing as they apply to messaging. Strong PowerShell skills (Exchange Online module, Microsoft Graph); experience with Power Automate or Logic Apps is desirable. Working understanding of DNS, firewalls, proxies and TLS certificates. Strong systematic troubleshooting: restore service first, then complete root-cause analysis. Experience managing incidents and changes through ServiceNow or a comparable IT service management platform. Communication Customer Support Ability to explain technical issues clearly to the audience and give concise, actionable updates. Comfortable working under time pressure, for example during an active phishing campaign, while keeping sound judgement. Professional written and spoken English suitable for global engineering, security and business teams. Personal Attributes Accountable: owns technical issues from first diagnosis through restoration, escalation and closure. Security-minded: balances protection against deliverability and user experience, and document why each decision was made. Calm, methodical and decisive during live incidents such as phishing campaigns or mail flow outages. Curious and committed to keeping up with changes in Microsoft 365, email standards and the threat landscape. Confident making recommendations, and comfortable admitting knowledge gaps and bringing in specialists. Collaborative and non-territorial, working well with security, identity, network and application teams. Organized and detail-oriented, with a commitment to documentation, standards, change control and knowledge transfer. Respectful and constructively challenging, able to push back on risky sender or relay requests without undermining colleagues. Comfortable working independently while staying connected to a globally distributed team. Overall Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is a strong messaging engineer who understands email end to end from SMTP and DNS on the wire, through Exchange Online and the security stack, to the people and applications that depend on it. They are neither only an Exchange administrator nor only a security analyst. They do not need expert knowledge of every product. More important is the breadth to understand how mail flow, security controls, identity and DNS interact, to isolate the likely fault quickly, and to engage the right specialists when needed. Hands-on Exchange Online and email security experience, strong SMTP troubleshooting, calm decision-making, clear communication and the ability to work at an experienced engineering level within a collaborative global team are essential. Desirable Qualifications Vendor Experience Microsoft 365 Certified: Messaging Administrator Associate, or equivalent experience. Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200) or Information Protection Administrator Associate (SC-400). Vendor training or certification from Proofpoint, Mimecast, Egress or a similar email security provider. Experience with DMARC reporting platforms. Experience in a large enterprise with many domains, business units or acquired companies. Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions or divestments: domain migration, coexistence and mail routing during transition. ITIL Foundation or equivalent service management knowledge.

title: Quality Analyst
description:
Quality Analyst
1. Summary
The Quality Analyst is responsible for monitoring and evaluating agent interactions to ensure adherence to quality, compliance, process, and client standards. The role will identify performance trends and gaps, provide actionable feedback, and partner with Operations and Training teams to drive continuous improvement and enhance customer experience.
2. Qualifications
• Minimum [X months/years] of experience in a contact center, Quality, Training, SME, or related support role.
• Strong understanding of APH processes, policies, quality standards, and customer service expectations.
• Consistent performance in the current role with a demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding performance expectations.
• Strong attendance and adherence to company policies.
• Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with teams and cross-functional stakeholders.
• Prior experience in quality monitoring, auditing, coaching, or performance evaluation is preferred.
3. Skills & Competencies
• Quality Assurance & Monitoring – Ability to evaluate interactions accurately against established quality standards.
• Communication Skills – Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate findings and provide constructive feedback.
• Analytical & Critical Thinking – Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and make fact-based assessments.
• Root Cause Analysis & Problem Solving – Ability to identify underlying issues and recommend effective solutions.
• Coaching & Feedback – Ability to provide clear, objective, and actionable feedback to support performance improvement.
• Policy, Process & Compliance Knowledge – Ability to consistently apply business processes, policies, and compliance requirements.
• Attention to Detail – Strong focus on accuracy, consistency, and identifying quality gaps.
• Reporting & Data Analysis – Ability to interpret quality data and communicate meaningful insights.
• Stakeholder Management – Ability to build effective relationships with agents, leadership, and cross-functional teams.
• Objectivity & Professional Judgment – Ability to evaluate performance fairly, consistently, and without bias.
4. Job Description
• Monitor and evaluate agent interactions against established quality, compliance, and client standards.
• Conduct quality evaluations and calibration sessions with accuracy and consistency.
• Identify quality gaps, trends, and recurring issues and recommend appropriate corrective actions.
• Provide timely and constructive feedback to improve agent performance and customer experience.
• Partner with Operations, Training, and other stakeholders to address performance and process gaps.
• Prepare and analyze quality reports and communicate key findings and trends to leadership.
• Ensure consistent application of quality guidelines, policies, procedures, and compliance requirements.
• Support quality improvement initiatives and recommend opportunities to improve processes and customer experience.
• Maintain effective communication with agents, peers, leadership, and cross-functional teams.
• Manage assigned evaluations, reporting, and quality activities within established timelines while maintaining accuracy.
