title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - Flow
description:
Job Description About Flow by ServiceNow Flow is a product and a new business unit in ServiceNow staffed by a team of 0-1 builders. We re creating Flow, an AI-native conversational experience for natural language automation and enterprise service management. Flow is built on a new tech stack with new ways of working. We challenge established practices and are defining a new product and GTM playbook for ServiceNow. Flow puts what we build in front of the largest possible audience. You ll have real ownership of the work, the freedom to move fast, and the resources of a global technology leader behind you. If you have a point of view on building and want to start from the beginning again, we want to talk to you, wherever you are. Plenty of people can ship an AI prototype this year. Few get to build a product that runs enterprise work at global scale. Join us. Job Description We are hiring a hands-on Senior Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer who serves as the technical champion for customers, guiding them from their first demo and trial to long-term success with Flow. You will demonstrate the product, answer technical questions, set up and enable Flow, and help customers build automations and integrations through AI-assisted, natural-language development. You will solve problems the product does not yet handle and translate customer needs into clear requirements that help product managers prioritize what to build next. The role combines technical implementation, customer success, and support. Ready to be the person who turns we re stuck into we re live We re looking for a hybrid problem-solver who helps trial customers and enterprise IT teams unlock the full power of Flow. You will own complex customer problems end to end, and your work will shape what Flow does next. What You Will Do Technical Solutions Work with customer IT and security teams to configure SSO and integrations with tools such as Okta, Microsoft Teams, Slack, and ServiceNow. Build, test, and launch automations with Flow s natural-language builder, connecting to tools such as Jira, Workday, Zoom, Microsoft 365, and ServiceNow. Connect document sources such as SharePoint, Google Drive, Box, Notion, and the ServiceNow knowledge base so the AI returns accurate, sourced answers. Solve complex customer requirements outside the standard product, document effective workarounds, and turn customer learnings into clear product requirements that you help refine and shepherd through delivery. Build proof-of-concept solutions and workflows for strategic evaluations. Customer Success and Adoption Guide new customers through a structured onboarding path, setting up and enabling Flow in a few hours so they can reach a live production deployment in one day. Monitor usage, conversation allowances, and automation results in Flow analytics, using the data to demonstrate value and identify new automation opportunities. Identify opportunities to expand Flow from an initial use case into a broader self-service service desk. Translate customer pain points and requests into clear product requirements, then partner with product and engineering to refine and shepherd them through delivery. Support and Reliability Own first-line triage for trial and enterprise customers, answering technical questions and escalating issues when deeper product or engineering support is needed. Be the go-to person when customers encounter API timeouts, sync errors, payment-related questions, or failed automations, and drive issues from initial diagnosis through resolution. Reproduce bugs, isolate root causes, and work directly with core engineers to resolve them. Monitor health, audit, and activity logs to identify outages or issues that prevent customers from using Flow fully. Use Flow audit and activity logs to diagnose complex customer issues, confirm what happened, and drive the issue to resolution. Qualifications 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role, such as forward deployed, solutions, or implementation engineering, in enterprise software. Hands-on experience with REST APIs, scripting, automations, and webhooks, with comfort testing them using tools such as Postman or cURL. Working knowledge of single sign-on and identity providers, including SAML, OAuth, Okta, and Entra ID. Experience with enterprise service management or collaboration tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, Slack, or Microsoft Teams. Familiarity with AI and workflow automation, including prompt design and how AI systems retrieve information from documents. Communicate clearly with stakeholders from IT directors to system administrators and security engineers. See how Flow fits into a customer s broader IT and operations strategy and ServiceNow s plans. Demonstrated ability to take ownership of customer outcomes while partnering effectively across product, engineering, support, and customer teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience with service desk offerings. Experience with AI-native or cloud-native enterprise products. Background in product-led growth or consumption-priced software. Experience building an onboarding or implementation motion from scratch; startup experience is helpful but not required.

title: QA Analyst
description:
What you'll be doing What We Need Corpay is currently looking to hire a QA Analyst with strong technical skills and solid backend experience within our Corporate Payments division. This position falls under our Corpay Cross Border line of business and is located in Chennai. In this role, you will work closely with Development and PM teams to maintain a top level of quality in software systems. You will report directly to one of our QA Managers and regularly collaborate with teams. This role combines manual testing, AI-assisted quality assurance, and test automation, with a primary focus on functional, integration, and regression testing. The successful candidate will leverage AI tools to enhance QA processes and identify opportunities to automate manual testing activities using Playwright and other modern automation practices. 
 How We Work 
As a QA Analyst, you will be expected to work 5 days in office from our Chennai location. Corpay will set you up for success by providing: Assigned workspace in Chennai office Company-issued equipment Hands-on training 
 Role Responsibilities 
The responsibilities of the role will include: Participating in story refinement sessions to help clarify requirements, identify risks, and propose clear, testable acceptance criteria. Analyzing business requirements and technical implementations to identify impacted areas and ensure appropriate test coverage across components and integrations. Designing and maintaining comprehensive QA test artifacts, including Test Strategies, Test Plans, Test Matrices, Test Scenarios, Test Cases, and Test Results documentation. Ensuring test cases provide full functional, integration, and regression coverage for new features, enhancements, and defect fixes. Executing manual and automated test cases covering functional, UI, API, integration, regression, and UAT testing. Validating end-to-end business workflows across multiple systems and services. Performing backend validation using SQL queries, API responses, and system logs as needed. Maintaining and updating regression test suites based on implemented changes. Investigating issues identified during testing or reported from production. Performing root cause analysis using logs, database queries, and system monitoring tools. Documenting defects clearly in Jira with detailed reproduction steps and supporting evidence. Working closely with developers and support teams to triage, prioritize, and resolve defects. Assisting with installation, configuration, and setup of tools and testing environments. Verifying application deployments and configuration changes across environments. Executing post-deployment validation and smoke testing to confirm system stability. Communicating testing progress, risks, and results to project stakeholders and management. Providing clear test execution reports, defect summaries, and quality metrics. Analyzing logs and system behavior to identify issues, trends, and improvement opportunities. Contributing to the continuous improvement of QA processes, tools, and test coverage. Collaborating with the team to expand automation coverage and improve testing efficiency. Continuously expanding knowledge of the business domain, applications, and backend systems. 
 Qualifications & Skills Bachelors degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). 5+ years of experience in software quality assurance, testing complex applications and integrations. Experience working in Agile / Scrum development environments. Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, test design techniques, and defect management processes. Experience testing complex applications with multiple services, integrations, and data flows. Ability to execute SQL queries to validate data and investigate issues at the database level. Understanding of database concepts, including tables, relationships, and stored procedures. Experience testing REST / SOAP APIs using tools such as Postman or similar tools. Understanding of API request/response structures, authentication mechanisms, and error handling. Ability to analyze application logs and system behavior to troubleshoot issues. Familiarity with test automation frameworks and automated testing practices. Experience using test management and issue tracking tools such as TestRail and Jira. Familiarity with CI/CD and deployment tools such as Bitbucket, Octopus, or similar platforms. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to clearly document defects, test results, and testing progress. Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, product owners, and cross-functional teams. Ability to leverage AI tools to improve testing efficiency, including test case creation, test data generation, defect analysis, and QA documentation. Experience creating effective prompts, reusable AI skills, and workflows that support test planning, execution, automation, and quality analysis. Experience using Playwright to automate functional tests and identify opportunities to reduce manual testing effort through practical, scalable automation solutions 
 Benefits & Perks Leaves: Earned, sick, casual, national holidays, maternity, paternity, bereavement, and adoption/surrogacy leave. Medical & Insurance: Group medical coverage for self and dependents; personal accident insurance. Wellness & Health: Wellness allowance and annual health check-ups for self and family. Tech & Meals: Broadband reimbursement and meal card support. Commute & Retirement: Commuting allowance, provident fund, gratuity, voluntary provident fund, and pension. Culture & Engagement: Support for philanthropic initiatives, fun contests, and an inclusive work environment.

description:
Network Switch Platform Test Engineer (PoE & Automation) This role has been designed as Hybrid with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office. Who We Are: Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE. What You ll Do: 
 Validate networking switch platforms through functional, regression, interoperability, and reliability testing. Design and execute PoE tests covering IEEE 802.3af/at/bt behavior, power negotiation, classification, allocation, power budgets, multi-port stress, and overload scenarios. Test copper and fiber interfaces across product-supported speeds-from multi-rate and 100 Mb/s through 1G, 10G, 25G, 40G, 100G and, where applicable, higher rates up to 800G. Validate link bring-up and recovery, auto-negotiation, FEC, channelization, MTU, VLAN, and LACP. Measure throughput, latency, packet loss, and interface error behavior. Validate platform and chassis behavior, including hardware bring-up, packet path, LEDs, route-engine behavior, boot/BIOS, and memory subsystems, as applicable. Translate market, hardware, and software requirements into test plans and Python automation for new features, typically within a few days. Maintain feature test automation and integrate suites into CI/CD pipelines where applicable. Analyze failures using logs, packet captures, counters, and platform diagnostics; work with development teams to identify root causes. Collaborate across hardware, firmware, and software teams to define coverage for new features and releases. Prepare test reports, defect summaries, and release quality metrics. Explore practical AI-assisted workflows that improve engineering efficiency and test delivery. 
 
 What You ll Bring: 
 Required qualifications and skills 
 Bachelor s degree in Electronics, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related field. Hands-on experience testing networking products, platforms, switches, interfaces, PoE, or closely related networking systems. Relevant platform testing on adjacent networking products, such as routing or security platforms, is also applicable. Strong understanding of networking fundamentals and how networks operate. Hands-on Python test automation, including the ability to translate feature specifications into repeatable tests and adapt scripts as requirements change. This role focuses on feature test automation; deep ownership of a standalone tooling platform is not required. Demonstrated technical depth in at least one relevant area, such as PoE, interfaces/optics, or platform/chassis validation. The complementary area can be learned on the job; experience in both is an advantage. Working knowledge of Linux, shell scripting, and Git. Strong debugging and communication skills in hardware/software integrated environments. Willingness to work in a hybrid, lab-dependent environment and attend the office more than two days in a week when business or testing needs require it. 
 Good to have 
 Experience across both PoE and interface/optics validation, including PoE standards, certification workflows, and power measurement setups. Knowledge of Layer 2 and Layer 3 features such as VLAN, STP/RSTP/MSTP, LACP, QoS, IGMP, and routing basics. EVPN/EVPN-VXLAN familiarity is useful. Familiarity with pytest or unittest, API/CLI automation, log parsing, and CI/CD integration. Experience with traffic generators such as IXIA, Spirent, TRex, or equivalent tools. Experience with SNMP, NETCONF/RESTCONF, gNMI, or telemetry validation. Experience with campus topologies, interoperability testing, and enterprise endpoints such as IP phones, wireless access points, and other PoE devices. Practical use of AI-assisted engineering workflows. 
 How Success Is Measured 
 High, repeatable automation coverage for PoE, interfaces, and platform regression. Reduced manual test-cycle time and stronger release confidence. Earlier detection and clear diagnosis of platform and interoperability defects. Stable test infrastructure that supports frequent product releases. Accessibility

title: QA Tester
description:
Job Summary Implements operational goals related to software build, release, deployment, and configuration management, ensuring smooth and stable application implementation. Contributes to the development and refinement of new processes, standards, and operational plans that support efficient software delivery. Manages smaller applications implementation projects and processes, coordinating release schedules, automation improvements, and integration efforts. Works on recurring but varied deployment challenges, requiring the analysis of multiple factors, including system dependencies, infrastructure constraints, and quality assurance measures. Communicates regularly with cross-functional teams, including QA, IT operations, and product teams, ensuring alignment and seamless software delivery. May interact with external partners, vendors, or customers to support implementation efforts and troubleshoot deployment-related issues. Position Summary Functional testers at Avantor validate the systems our customers and partners use to do business with us. That means B2B ordering and account flows, e-commerce transactions, and the web services that tie them together. The work is hands-on. Read the requirement, work out what could go wrong, write the tests, run them, and raise what you find with enough detail that a developer can act on it without coming back to ask. Most testing here spans more than one system. An order placed on the web front end touches pricing, inventory, customer account data, and downstream fulfilment. Testers who can follow a transaction across those boundaries, rather than checking one screen at a time, do well in this role. Key Responsibilities Test design and execution Read requirements and user stories, then write test cases that cover the normal path, the edge cases, and the ways the feature can fail. Run functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing against web and B2B applications. Build and maintain test data that reflects real customer and account scenarios. Test on different browsers and devices where the application calls for it. Verify fixes and confirm that nothing else broke on the way. API and web services testing Test REST and SOAP services directly using tools such as Postman or SoapUI. Check request and response payloads, status codes, error handling, and data types against the contract. Validate authentication, authorisation, and session behaviour on service calls. Trace data through service layers to work out whether a defect sits in the front end, the service, or the data behind it. Write and run SQL queries to confirm what the application actually stored. Defects and communication Raise defects with clear reproduction steps, expected and actual behaviour, environment detail, and evidence attached. Work with developers through triage, retest, and closure. Report test progress, coverage, and open risk to the QA Manager. Join sprint ceremonies and raise testability concerns while a story is still being shaped. Estimate testing effort and flag risk to release dates early. Identify candidates for automation and work with the automation team to hand them over. Represent QA in requirement and design discussions with business stakeholders. Required Qualifications QA Functional Tester Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years in functional software testing. Hands-on experience testing web applications, including B2B or e-commerce systems. Working experience testing REST or SOAP services with Postman, SoapUI, or similar. Able to write SQL queries to verify data. Experience with a test management tool such as Jira, ALM, or TestRail. Writes defects that a developer can act on without a follow-up conversation. Preferred Qualifications Experience with enterprise B2B commerce platforms, for example IMCM or comparable customer-facing order and account systems. SAP exposure, particularly order-to-cash or customer master data. Familiarity with test automation, enough to read a script and know what it covers even without writing one. Experience in a regulated industry such as life sciences. Performance or accessibility testing background. ISTQB certification or equivalent.

About the Role As a Senior Software Test Automation Engineer, you will design, develop, and evolve modern test automation solutions that improve software quality, engineering velocity, and test coverage. This is a highly hands-on engineering role focused on Playwright, TypeScript, API automation, CI/CD, and AI-enabled quality engineering. You will work closely with software engineers, product teams, and QE leaders to build scalable, maintainable automation and embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle. You will also explore and apply Agentic AI, LLM-based testing, AI-assisted test generation, self-healing automation, and intelligent test analysis to modernize traditional quality engineering practices. The successful candidate is a strong software engineer who understands testing deeply and can translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, reliable QE solution Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable UI and API automation frameworks using Playwright and TypeScript. Develop robust automated tests covering functional, regression, integration, API, and end-to-end scenarios. Define and implement automation architecture, coding standards, reusable components, and testing patterns. Partner with developers and product teams to establish testability, acceptance criteria, and automation strategy early in the development lifecycle. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and enable reliable, repeatable execution. Analyze automation failures, identify root causes, and improve test reliability and maintainability. Reduce flaky tests through effective synchronization, resilient locators, test isolation, test data management, and failure diagnostics. Develop reusable automation utilities, libraries, skills, and tools that can be leveraged across teams and applications. Apply Agentic AI and LLM capabilities to areas such as automated test generation, test case optimization and coverage analysis, AI-assisted test maintece, self-healing or resilient automation, failure analysis and root-cause identification, test data generation, requirements-to-test traceability, intelligent regression selection, and LLM/AI application testing and evaluation. Explore and implement AI agents, MCP-based integrations, and AI-assisted QE workflows where they provide measurable value. Develop or contribute to evaluation strategies for AI-powered applications, including LLM response validation, hallucination detection, prompt evaluation, rubrics, golden datasets, and quality metrics. Participate in architecture and code reviews and provide technical guidance on automation best practices. Troubleshoot complex automation, environment, test-data, and integration issues. Contribute to performance, reliability, and scalability testing as needed. Monitor automation effectiveness using metrics such as coverage, execution time, stability, defect detection, and maintece effort. Mentor other engineers and promote modern automation and quality engineering practices. Continuously evaluate emerging testing technologies and AI capabilities and identify opportunities to improve QE productivity and quality. Required Qualifications Bachelors degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. 5+ years of software test automation or quality engineering experience, with strong hands-on engineering experience. Strong hands-on experience with Playwright. Strong programming experience with TypeScript and/or JavaScript. Strong understanding of UI, API, integration, and end-to-end automation. Experience designing or contributing to test automation frameworks and architecture. Strong understanding of software development practices, Git, code reviews, debugging, and CI/CD. Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitLab. Experience with API testing and tools/frameworks such as REST, Postman, Playwright API, or equivalent. Strong understanding of test design techniques, test strategy, test coverage, and risk-based testing. Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex automation failures and identify root causes. Experience working in Agile/Scrum software development environments. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Agentic AI / AI Testing Experience Generative AI / LLM application testing AI-assisted software development or test automation AI agents / Agentic AI workflows MCP or similar agent-to-tool integration frameworks AI-generated test cases or test scripts LLM evaluation and testing Prompt engineering and prompt evaluation RAG testing and evaluation Hallucination and factuality testing Golden datasets and evaluation datasets Rubric-based evaluation AI-powered test maintece or self-healing automation AI-based failure analysis or test-result summarization Experience using tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or other AI coding/testing assistants Required Qualifications Experience with Playwright using TypeScript at enterprise scale. Experience migrating automation from Selenium to Playwright. Experience with BDD/Gherkin and translating requirements or acceptance criteria into automated tests. Experience with test management and defect tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, qTest, or equivalent. Experience building reusable internal automation libraries, tools, AI agents, or developer/QE skills. Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or LLM application architectures. Experience establishing quality metrics and automation effectiveness measures. You will design automated test suites, run them continuously against our environments, and help the team ship platform changes with confidence. 
 Key responsibilities Analyse cloud platform features and changes, then write test plans, test scenarios and test cases covering functional, integration, regression and negative paths. Support performance and scale testing with tools like Rally, and report on latency, throughput and capacity limits. Maintain test environments and test data, and keep the automation framework clean, reusable and documented. Publish test reports and quality metrics (pass rate, coverage, defect trends) to engineering and operations teams.• Work closely with platform, network and storage engineers during sprint planning, release readiness and production change validation.

Strong programming skills in Python (preferred) or Java/Go for writing test code. Hands-on experience with automation frameworks such as Pytest and playwright. Who We Are: Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today s complex world. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE. What You ll Do: 
 Validate networking switch platforms through functional, regression, interoperability, and reliability testing. Design and execute PoE tests covering IEEE 802.3af/at/bt behavior, power negotiation, classification, allocation, power budgets, multi-port stress, and overload scenarios. Test copper and fiber interfaces across product-supported speeds-from multi-rate and 100 Mb/s through 1G, 10G, 25G, 40G, 100G and, where applicable, higher rates up to 800G. Validate link bring-up and recovery, auto-negotiation, FEC, channelization, MTU, VLAN, and LACP. Measure throughput, latency, packet loss, and interface error behavior. Validate platform and chassis behavior, including hardware bring-up, packet path, LEDs, route-engine behavior, boot/BIOS, and memory subsystems, as applicable. Translate market, hardware, and software requirements into test plans and Python automation for new features, typically within a few days. Maintain feature test automation and integrate suites into CI/CD pipelines where applicable. Analyze failures using logs, packet captures, counters, and platform diagnostics; work with development teams to identify root causes. Collaborate across hardware, firmware, and software teams to define coverage for new features and releases. Prepare test reports, defect summaries, and release quality metrics. Explore practical AI-assisted workflows that improve engineering efficiency and test delivery. 
 
 What You ll Bring: 
 Required qualifications and skills 
 Bachelor s degree in Electronics, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related field. Hands-on experience testing networking products, platforms, switches, interfaces, PoE, or closely related networking systems. Relevant platform testing on adjacent networking products, such as routing or security platforms, is also applicable. Strong understanding of networking fundamentals and how networks operate. Hands-on Python test automation, including the ability to translate feature specifications into repeatable tests and adapt scripts as requirements change. This role focuses on feature test automation; deep ownership of a standalone tooling platform is not required. Demonstrated technical depth in at least one relevant area, such as PoE, interfaces/optics, or platform/chassis validation. The complementary area can be learned on the job; experience in both is an advantage. Working knowledge of Linux, shell scripting, and Git. Strong debugging and communication skills in hardware/software integrated environments. Willingness to work in a hybrid, lab-dependent environment and attend the office more than two days in a week when business or testing needs require it. 
 Good to have 
 Experience across both PoE and interface/optics validation, including PoE standards, certification workflows, and power measurement setups. Knowledge of Layer 2 and Layer 3 features such as VLAN, STP/RSTP/MSTP, LACP, QoS, IGMP, and routing basics. EVPN/EVPN-VXLAN familiarity is useful. Familiarity with pytest or unittest, API/CLI automation, log parsing, and CI/CD integration. Experience with traffic generators such as IXIA, Spirent, TRex, or equivalent tools. Experience with SNMP, NETCONF/RESTCONF, gNMI, or telemetry validation. Experience with campus topologies, interoperability testing, and enterprise endpoints such as IP phones, wireless access points, and other PoE devices. Practical use of AI-assisted engineering workflows.

 High, repeatable automation coverage for PoE, interfaces, and platform regression. Reduced manual test-cycle time and stronger release confidence. title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Role & responsibilities Company is hiring a GCP Infrastructure Engineer to support cloud operations, platform implementation, and day-to-day infrastructure management for a client's Google Cloud Platform environment. Working under the guidance of the GCP Infrastructure Architect, you will build, operate, and improve the landing zone, security controls, and automation that keep the platform reliable and cost-efficient. 
 Implement and maintain GCP infrastructure components VPC networking, IAM roles, org policies, and resource hierarchy in line with the approved architecture. Provision and manage cloud resources using Terraform (or equivalent IaC), following established standards and code review practices. Apply and monitor security controls, including access management, encryption, and policy enforcement. Set up and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting using Cloud Monitoring / Cloud Logging and related observability tooling. Handle L2 operational support: troubleshoot incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and escalate to the architect where needed. Execute planned changes, patching, and maintenance activities following ITIL-aligned change management processes. Collaborate with the DevOps, Data Engineering, Network Engineering, and Infra/OS team members in the offshore delivery pod. Identify cost-optimisation opportunities (rightsizing, idle resources, committed use) and support their implementation. Maintain clear technical documentation, runbooks, and SOPs for the managed services engagement. 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 45 years of experience in cloud infrastructure or operations roles, with at least 23 years of hands-on work on Google Cloud Platform. Practical experience with core GCP services: Compute Engine, VPC, Cloud IAM, Cloud Storage, GKE, Cloud Load Balancing, and Cloud DNS. Working knowledge of GCP landing zone concepts (networking, IAM, org policy, resource hierarchy). Hands-on experience with Terraform or equivalent IaC tools, and Git-based workflows. Understanding of cloud security fundamentals (IAM, service accounts, VPC firewall rules, encryption). Familiarity with monitoring/observability tools and Linux system administration. Scripting skills in Bash, Python, or similar. Exposure to hybrid/on-prem connectivity (Cloud VPN / Interconnect) is a plus. Good communication skills and willingness to work with international (Middle East) client stakeholders. Preferred Certifications Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer (strongly preferred) Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect (nice to have) ITIL Foundation (useful for the managed services context) Engagement Details Delivery location: Offshore (India-based delivery pod), with periodic coordination with the onsite Delivery/Project Manager. Team context: Reports to the GCP Infrastructure Architect; works alongside GCP DevOps, Data, Network, and Infra/OS engineers and L1 support staff. Allocation: Full-time, dedicated to the client account for the duration of the engagement. Success Metrics Infrastructure changes delivered on time, to standard, and with no security or compliance findings. Platform uptime/reliability targets met per the managed services SLA. Incidents resolved within SLA, with clear documentation and root-cause analysis. Measurable progress on automation and cost-optimisation initiatives.

Summary: 
-The Scrum Master Core Infrastructure serves as the agile delivery lead and servant-leader across the Compute OS, Storage Backup, Database Middleware, and Cloud Platform engineering towers. The role is responsible for facilitating agile ceremonies, removing delivery impediments, co-ordinating cross-tower dependencies, and embedding a culture of continuous improvement across infrastructure engineering teams in a regulated financial services environment.
-Core infrastructure delivery has distinct characteristics that separate it from software development change control windows, vendor hardware lead times, patching freeze periods, DR testing cycles, and regulatory maintenance obligations all shape sprint cadence and capacity. This role demands works within them effectively, and continuously drives the team toward greater delivery predictability and operational efficiency.
 
Roles Responsibilities: 
Agile Delivery Sprint Management
Facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives across all four infrastructure towers ensuring ceremonies are purposeful, time-boxed, and produce actionable outcomes
Own and maintain the infrastructure delivery backlog in collaboration with platform owners and technical leads ensuring stories are well-defined, technically scoped, and sprint-ready with clear acceptance criteria
Track and report sprint velocity, delivery metrics, and team capacity producing transparent, accurate reporting for engineering management and programme governance forumsManage cross-tower dependencies Compute, Storage, Database, and Cloud workstreams frequently intersect on major programmes (server builds, DR tests, cloud migrations) the Scrum Master ensures these are visible, sequenced, and resolved before they impact sprint outcomes
Drive backlog refinement sessions translating infrastructure work items (server builds, patching cycles, storage migrations, DR rehearsals) into sprint-deliverable stories with measurable done criteria
Facilitate continuous improvement through structured retrospectives capturing actions, tracking follow-through, and promoting a culture of accountability across all towers
Impediment Removal Stakeholder Management
Proactively identify, escalate, and remove delivery blockers spanning procurement, vendor lead times, change approval delays, resource constraints, and cross-team dependencies
Serve as the primary delivery status contact for all four towers communicating sprint progress, risks, and dependencies clearly to programme managers, infrastructure leadership, and senior stakeholders
Co-ordinate with ITSM change management, CAB, and release management teams to align sprint deliverables with approved change windows, maintenance schedules, and freeze periods
Manage vendor, OEM, and TAC engagement timelines where they create sprint dependencies escalating when resolution SLAs are at risk and tracking through to closure
Shield sprint commitments from unplanned scope injection managing stakeholder expectations proactively when operational incidents, emergency changes, or business-critical requests compete with planned work
Support major incident and problem management co-ordination as a delivery resource when infrastructure events impact sprint workstreams or require engineering team engagement
Infrastructure-Specific Delivery Practices
Maintain awareness of infrastructure delivery constraints hardware lead times, firmware and OS patching schedules, DR testing windows, licence renewals, and end-of-life milestones and factor these into sprint planning and capacity management

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - Flow
description:
Job Description About Flow by ServiceNow Flow is a product and a new business unit in ServiceNow staffed by a team of 0-1 builders. We re creating Flow, an AI-native conversational experience for natural language automation and enterprise service management. Flow is built on a new tech stack with new ways of working. We challenge established practices and are defining a new product and GTM playbook for ServiceNow. Flow puts what we build in front of the largest possible audience. You ll have real ownership of the work, the freedom to move fast, and the resources of a global technology leader behind you. If you have a point of view on building and want to start from the beginning again, we want to talk to you, wherever you are. Plenty of people can ship an AI prototype this year. Few get to build a product that runs enterprise work at global scale. Join us. Job Description We are hiring a hands-on Senior Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer who serves as the technical champion for customers, guiding them from their first demo and trial to long-term success with Flow. You will demonstrate the product, answer technical questions, set up and enable Flow, and help customers build automations and integrations through AI-assisted, natural-language development. You will solve problems the product does not yet handle and translate customer needs into clear requirements that help product managers prioritize what to build next. The role combines technical implementation, customer success, and support. Ready to be the person who turns we re stuck into we re live We re looking for a hybrid problem-solver who helps trial customers and enterprise IT teams unlock the full power of Flow. You will own complex customer problems end to end, and your work will shape what Flow does next. What You Will Do Technical Solutions Work with customer IT and security teams to configure SSO and integrations with tools such as Okta, Microsoft Teams, Slack, and ServiceNow. Build, test, and launch automations with Flow s natural-language builder, connecting to tools such as Jira, Workday, Zoom, Microsoft 365, and ServiceNow. Connect document sources such as SharePoint, Google Drive, Box, Notion, and the ServiceNow knowledge base so the AI returns accurate, sourced answers. Solve complex customer requirements outside the standard product, document effective workarounds, and turn customer learnings into clear product requirements that you help refine and shepherd through delivery. Build proof-of-concept solutions and workflows for strategic evaluations. Customer Success and Adoption Guide new customers through a structured onboarding path, setting up and enabling Flow in a few hours so they can reach a live production deployment in one day. Monitor usage, conversation allowances, and automation results in Flow analytics, using the data to demonstrate value and identify new automation opportunities.
